title: SanaCkoala
description:
[b]SanaCkoala[/b] adds three playable characters to Slay the Spire 2: the Koala, the Panda, and the unlockable Black Cat. All three work in singleplayer, and they are built to play well together in co-op.

[h2]The Koala[/h2]
70 HP. Starter relic: [b]Eucalyptus Leaf[/b] (start each combat with 3 Drowsy). Touch of Orobas upgrades it to [b]Eucalyptus Crown[/b] (6 Drowsy).
[list]
[*][b]Drowsy[/b]: at the end of your turn, gain Block equal to your Drowsy.
[*][b]Waking up[/b]: some cards remove all of your Drowsy at once for a big effect.
[*]Three ways to play: build a Hibernation Fortress that stays Drowsy; bank Drowsy for an Alarm Burst; or manage a hand of Dream and Retain cards.
[/list]

[h2]The Panda[/h2]
80 HP. Starter relic: [b]Bamboo Basket[/b] (start each combat with 3 Bamboo). Touch of Orobas upgrades it to [b]Bamboo Hamper[/b] (6 Bamboo).
[list]
[*][b]Bamboo[/b] is a resource you gather with cards and powers.
[*][b]Munch N[/b]: if you have at least N Bamboo, the card spends it and triggers a bonus effect.
[*][b]Full[/b]: your first Munch each turn gives one Full, which feeds the menu, belly and Roll cards.
[*]Four ways to play: Full menu choices, Block and counterattacks, multi-hit Strength turns, or building and spending Roll momentum.
[/list]

[h2]The Black Cat (unlockable)[/h2]
68 HP. Unlock it by winning Act 3 with the Koala and the Panda in the same party, or by winning Act 3 once with each of them (separate runs and singleplayer count). Starter relic: [b]Moonbell Collar[/b] (start each combat with the middle Footprint slot set to S). Touch of Orobas upgrades it to [b]Eclipse Chime[/b].
[list]
[*][b]Footprints[/b]: three slots above the health bar remember the types of your last cards, A (Attack), S (Skill) and P (Power). They carry over between turns.
[*]Finish a Line to trigger it and clear the slots: [b]Pounce[/b] A-S-A (8 damage, 1 Vulnerable), [b]Groom[/b] S-S-A (8 Block, draw 1), [b]Omen[/b] P-S-P (1 Energy, Retain 1 card).
[*]Cards can Set, Rotate or Lock slots to line up the next Line, and Companion cards make your next matching card help a chosen ally.
[/list]

Each character has 87 cards (3 Basic, 20 Common, 36 Uncommon, 26 Rare and 2 Ancient), the same split as the vanilla characters. Each also has seven relics on top of the starter relic, and three potions.

[h2]Ancient cards and events[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Archaic Tooth[/b] turns Doze into Deep Sleep and Gather Bamboo into Bamboo Harvest.
[*][b]Dusty Tome[/b] gives the Koala Lazy Sunday and the Panda Rolling Thunder.
[*]Twelve events appear only in runs with the Koala or the Panda, such as The Last Dumpling, Eucalyptus Tollbooth, Dream Exchange and The Summit Picnic.
[*]Two enchantments come from these events: [b]Well-Rested[/b] (a Retained card gives Block) and [b]Freshly-Cut[/b] (a Panda card that Munches gives a short damage boost).
[/list]

[h2]Co-op content[/h2]
In multiplayer runs, both characters start with [b]Hold Hands[/b], and five more colorless cards can appear: [b]Share a Bite[/b], [b]Quarrel[/b], [b]Make Up[/b], [b]Assist[/b] and [b]Promise[/b]. The Koala has five co-op cards of its own and the Panda has seven, such as [b]Wake-Up Kiss[/b], [b]Pajama Party[/b], [b]Piggyback Charge[/b] and [b]Partner in Crime[/b]. The Black Cat has ten, such as [b]Two-Beat Signal[/b], [b]Shared Perch[/b] and [b]Moonlit Relay[/b]. Each character also has a co-op relic, three shared relics can drop, and several events need a second player. Co-op cards that give resources target one ally you choose. None of this shows up in singleplayer.

[h2]Installation[/h2]
[list]
[*]Requires [b]BaseLib[/b]. Steam asks you to subscribe to it as well.
[*]Subscribe and start the game. The first time, the game asks whether to load mods; allow it.
[*]For multiplayer, every player needs this mod on the same version.
[*]Do not also keep a manual copy in the game's [i]mods[/i] folder.
[*]The Black Cat unlock is saved in the mod's own progress file for each player, not in the game save.
[*]Modded play uses a separate set of save files. Your unmodded saves are not touched. On a fresh modded save, the mod still starts act 1 with Neow.
[/list]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
Tested on game version v0.107.1 only. Other versions may not load.

Source code and full README: [url=https://github.com/PingChunChung/spire-duo]GitHub[/url]

Fan-made mod, not affiliated with or endorsed by Mega Crit. Card art, icons and character images made with AI image generation.
changeNote:
[b]v1.0.0[/b]
[list]
[*]New unlockable character: the [b]Black Cat[/b] (68 HP). Win Act 3 with the Koala and the Panda in the same party, or win Act 3 once with each of them (separate runs and singleplayer count), to unlock it. A banner appears on the victory screen, and the character select icon is dimmed until then. Each player's unlock is saved in the mod's own progress file; game saves are not changed.
[*]The Black Cat plays with [b]Footprints[/b]: three slots above the health bar remember the types of your last cards (A, S, P) and carry over between turns. A-S-A triggers Pounce (8 damage, 1 Vulnerable), S-S-A triggers Groom (8 Block, draw 1) and P-S-P triggers Omen (1 Energy, Retain 1 card).
[*]87 Black Cat cards (3 Basic, 20 Common, 36 Uncommon, 26 Rare, 2 Ancient), including Set, Rotate and Lock cards that rearrange Footprints, and ten co-op cards such as Two-Beat Signal, Shared Perch and Moonlit Relay.
[*]Starter relic Moonbell Collar, upgraded to Eclipse Chime by Touch of Orobas, plus seven relics: Velvet Pouch, Windowsill Token, Quiet Hourglass, Gutter Crown, Comet Comb, Lantern of One Window (co-op) and Curiosity String.
[*]Three potions: Pawprint Draught, Moonmilk Flask and Ninth Spark.
[*]Ancient cards: Night Atlas and Cat of the Threshold.
[*]Full art set for the Black Cat: character select background, portrait, combat body, map marker, energy orb, rest site and merchant poses, chest hand, Footprint icons, art for all 87 cards, and icons for every new power, relic and potion.
[*]Card art is now compressed. The download is about 62 MB instead of 197 MB, with no visible change in game.
[/list]
Every player needs to update before playing together.
Source and details: [url=https://github.com/PingChunChung/spire-duo]GitHub[/url]

[b]v1.0.0[/b]
[list]
[*]新增解鎖角色[b]黑貓[/b]（68 HP）。隊伍裡同時有無尾熊和熊貓並打贏第 3 幕，或分別用無尾熊和熊貓各打贏第 3 幕一次（不同局、單人都算），就會解鎖，勝利畫面會跳出提示；解鎖前選角圖示是暗的。解鎖紀錄存在每位玩家各自的 mod 進度檔，不會改到遊戲存檔。
[*]黑貓的核心是[b]足跡[/b]：血條上方三格記下最近打出的牌種類（A、S、P），跨回合保留。A-S-A 觸發撲擊（8 傷害、1 易傷），S-S-A 觸發理毛（8 格擋、抽 1），P-S-P 觸發預兆（1 能量、保留 1 張牌）。
[*]黑貓有 87 張卡（3 基本、20 普通、36 罕見、26 稀有、2 先古），包含設定、旋轉、鎖定足跡的卡，以及 10 張雙人卡，例如雙拍暗號、共棲高處、月下接力。
[*]起始遺物月鈴項圈，歐洛巴斯之觸會升級成日蝕風鈴；另有 7 個遺物：絨布小袋、窗臺代幣、靜時沙漏、雨槽王冠、彗星梳、獨窗燈（雙人）、好奇繩。
[*]3 瓶藥水：爪印藥劑、月乳瓶、第九火花。
[*]先古卡：夜行星圖、門檻之貓。
[*]黑貓全套美術：選角背景、頭像、戰鬥立繪、地圖標記、能量球、休息處和商店姿勢、寶箱房的貓掌、足跡圖示，87 張卡圖，以及所有新能力、遺物和藥水的圖示。
[*]卡圖改成壓縮格式，下載量從 197 MB 降到約 62 MB，遊戲內看不出差別。
[/list]
多人連線前，每位玩家都要先更新。
原始碼與詳細說明：[url=https://github.com/PingChunChung/spire-duo]GitHub[/url]
